title: Animated Mod Menu Icons
description: This mod allows for animated mod icons in Mod Menu
body:
Animated Mod Menu Icons (AMMI) adds support for animated mod icons in Mod Menu using Minecraft's built-in `.mcmeta` animation format.

By default, this mod doesn't change anything. It simply enables other mods to provide animated icons in Mod Menu. Mods that don't include animated icons are completely unaffected.

The animated icon used by AMMI itself is included as an example of what is possible. Credit for the original icon design goes to the Mod Menu project.

## For Mod Developers

AMMI is designed to be simple to integrate.

Keep your existing icon for when AMMI is not installed:

```text
assets/examplemod/icon.png
```

Then add an animated version alongside it:

```text
assets/examplemod/icon.animation.png
assets/examplemod/icon.animation.png.mcmeta
```

Your `fabric.mod.json` should continue to reference the normal icon:

```json
{
  "icon": "assets/examplemod/icon.png"
}
```

AMMI will automatically detect `icon.animation.png` and use it whenever it is installed. If AMMI isn't present, Mod Menu will simply display the normal static icon.

![Example folder layout](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2376c249f82dd97271531723d0e3eddecb5ce3b8.png)

## Animation

Animations use Minecraft's standard `.mcmeta` format, so they behave exactly like animated textures in resource packs.

Example:

```json
{
  "animation": {
    "frametime": 4,
    "interpolate": false
  }
}
```

The animated image should be a vertical strip of square frames.

Example `icon.animation.png`:

![Example animation strip](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27981ca507afea70ddb0aeb9a23a3d0464daca6c.png)

Which appears like this in-game:

![Animated icon example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73b14306dbfc37ff1802cfc3de7448b856e75d4a.gif)
